title: Sources: more than two dozen prediction-market ETFs have been pushed back as the SEC seeks more information; they were originally expected to launch this week (Suzanne McGee/Reuters)
summary: Suzanne McGee / Reuters: Sources: more than two dozen prediction-market ETFs have been pushed back as the SEC seeks more information; they were originally expected to launch this week — More than two dozen exchange-traded funds tied to elections, recessions, tech layoffs and other real-world events …
